rows.ct1: scalar SSA statement: atom assignment, conversion, comparison, arithmetic, bit operation, select, block yield, over a scalar, an enum, or an option/result; an operation used directly as a return operand or match-arm expression contributes this row
constructor of option/result outside a match arm, including a return operand; charged once, with the return row separate (owner clarification RD-3=2, 2026-10-14)

whole aggregate value of L lanes (R-WB-26b): construction (struct.new, array.new), assignment, call argument (in c1), yield, match-arm yield, return (with the return row), the result of struct.set and array.set, an aggregate-typed element or field extraction, the fold accumulator; steps L, once per transfer
element or field access with a static index or an O(1) dynamic index: struct.get, struct.set, array.get, array.set, table.get; the index domain check included
check that a value enters a refined type from another type: assignment, call argument, yield, return or ingress; charged even when lowering elides the check
match with k arms: steps 1+k (dispatch compare chain), plus the componentwise max over the arms' block summaries
an atom arm, including a constructor atom, costs 0; an atom arm that yields an aggregate local is one aggregate.transfer row instead
return: steps 1 (plus a refinement check row if applicable; plus one aggregate.transfer row for an aggregate result)
local call, sub-node c2 = c1 + (steps 1, calls 1); c3 = c2 + B(f); c1 = one aggregate.transfer row per aggregate argument, in argument order (empty if none)
host extern call to key k: (steps 1, effects[k] 1)
structured branch: steps 1 + max(then, else)
bounded loop, sub-node t1 = (steps 1, iterations 1) + Bd
bounded loop, sub-node t3 = (steps 1 + L_T) + t2; L_T is one aggregate.transfer row for an aggregate accumulator, nothing otherwise
